title: Mike S Probable NDE 3350
content: I'm not sure if I'm prepared to share all my experiences. What I did experience was being back at my grandpa and grandma's farm. I was younger, more like a teenager. I also communicated with a couple of my uncles who have passed away already. I also remember seeing my grandma and grandpa, but not really talking to them. Everyone was younger. Again, I'm just starting to share my experience. My wife has been the only one who I've talked to about this and she doesn't even know all the details. I just seemed to be depressed lately and I hope this helps or someone can help me cope with this. I'm not sure what to do. Any advice you could provide, I would appreciate.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Surgery-related 'Illness, trauma or other condition not considered life threatening' I hemorrhaged three days after being sent home from my original surgery, which was to remove an AVM (arteriovenous malformation). I was flown by helicopter from Princeton, Minnesota back to St. Mary's for emergency surgery.
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Normal consciousness and alertness That's really hard to determine.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: It seemed that I saw everything in more detail and more color.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Uncertain It was more like being transported. The colors where unbelievable.
elements.The experience included: Presence of deceased persons | Light | A landscape or city | Life review
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Uncertain It was more like an array of colors. Like the Northern lights.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Again, just my grandparents farm
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Happiness, relief. Everything was very peaceful. One could say it was almost perfect.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control It's difficult to say. At first I thought I was reliving part of my childhood, but it was much more than that. Again, everyone seemed younger and everyone seemed to be at complete peace. I felt completely at ease, almost euphoric.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes I make sure I go to church every Sunday. I find myself trying to pray every day. It really helps.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I make sure I go to church every Sunday. I find myself trying to pray every day. It really helps.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes That my time on earth was not done yet.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes I seem to be more relaxed and try to be nicer to everyone I meet.
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I seem to be more relaxed and try to be nicer to everyone I meet. After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Uncertain Remembering all the details of my experience. As time goes on, I seem to remember more.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Uncertain Possible to help people heal.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Before coming back. One of my uncles told me I had to go back. That I was going to watch my three girls grow up and watch them become adults and enjoy my future grandkids.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: I would almost prefer to talk to someone, versus typing it all.
